Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a pioneering chemical company located in the heart of New York City at 363 East 42nd Street, NY, NY 10017. Established with a vision to become a leader in the chemical industry, Standardpharm specializes in the development and production of innovative chemical solutions that cater to a diverse range of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and specialty chemicals. With a commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability, the company leverages cutting-edge technology and rigorous research methodologies to deliver products that meet the highest industry standards.

At Standardpharm, we understand the critical role that chemistry plays in improving everyday life and addressing global challenges. Our highly skilled team of scientists and industry experts work collaboratively to drive research and development initiatives, focusing on creating efficient and eco-friendly chemical processes. By prioritizing environmental responsibility, we ensure that our products are not only effective but also sustainable.

Our state-of-the-art facilities in New York enable us to maintain strict quality control at every stage of production. We are dedicated to fostering long-term partnerships with our clients, providing them with tailored solutions that enhance their operations and contribute to their success. As we continue to expand our reach within the global market, Standardpharm remains committed to innovation, integrity, and excellence in the chemical industry.
